collateralizationRatio.rationale: System CR = sum over active (non-zero debt) pairs of collateralVault.convertToAssets(collateralShares) / sum of pair totalBorrow from getPairAccounting() = 34635150.457250 / 32177832.888000 = 1.076367. Registry enumerated 19 pairs; 15 active with debt, 4 zero-debt pairs excluded from the ratio (their residual converted assets not counted as debt-backing). reUSD totalSupply 32171263.13 vs totalDebt 32177832.89 (0.0204% divergence). Collateral is ERC-4626 lending-vault shares on crvUSD/frxUSD markets valued at vault conversion, not a guarantee of instant underlying liquidity.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: InsurancePool reUSD balanceOf / total active pair debt = 2546294.855477 / 32177832.888000 = 0.079132. Insurance Pool docs state deposited reUSD is used to insure bad debt and to buy liquidated collateral (burned on use). Dual-source: on-chain balanceOf at InsurancePool 0x00000000efe883b3304aFf71eaCf72Dbc3e1b577 + Insurance Pool documentation.

collateralizationParameters.basis: Per-pair CDP accounting is on-chain (getPairAccounting borrow + collateral shares; convertToAssets for vault claim). System CR only ~1.076 at pin — thin buffer versus conventional overcollateralized CDPs. Collateral is layered ERC-4626 claims on crvUSD/frxUSD lending markets at accounting par, not direct blue-chip collateral. Limited: parameters exist and are measurable, but effective LTV is high and underlying is already a stablecoin lending claim.

liquidationMechanics.basis: Insurance Pool documentation: on liquidation the pool buys collateral with reUSD (burned), liquidated collateral routes through LiquidationHandler which withdraws underlying from the lending pool when liquidity allows (can retry). Dual-source: Insurance Pool CDP Liquidations section + on-chain InsurancePool capital committed at pin (7.91% of debt).

backstop.basis: Insurance Pool is the explicit bad-debt and liquidation backstop (docs + 2.546M reUSD on-chain). If bad debt exceeds the pool, docs state the protocol assumes residual bad debt and leftover collateral is held by the protocol — no unconditional external recapitalization. Limited depth at 7.91% of debt.

branchIsolation.basis: Pairs are separate contracts with distinct collateral vaults (19 registry addresses observed). Redeemer may choose which pools to redeem against (Stability Mechanics). Cross-pair transmission exists via shared Insurance Pool and communal redemption. Limited isolation: pair-level accounting exists but insurance and redemptions are system-shared.

shutdownAndBadDebt.basis: Defined bad-debt path: Insurance Pool purchases impaired collateral and burns reUSD; residual beyond the pool is assumed by the protocol with collateral held for pool holders to withdraw (Insurance Pool Bad Debt section). No dual-sourced global settlement/emergency shutdown. Limited, not adequate.

structuralRedemption.basis: Communal redemption model with ~1% fee establishing a price floor (Stability Mechanics docs): redeemer burns reUSD against borrower collateral across chosen pairs with weighted discounts. Access is conditional (operator/oracle-price guard on RedemptionHandler per prior pinned implementation family). Limited structural redemption rather than unconditional 1:1 cash redeem.
